technique "MainTec0" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=1
  script "RenderColorTarget=;Pass=DrawFog;"
  cmd 0 RenderColorTarget0 param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 1 Pass pass="DrawFog" index=0 text="DrawFog"
  pass 0 "DrawFog" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1

  select object 0-1 "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0"

  select shadow 0-1 "ShadowTech"
  select edge 0-1 "EdgeTec"
  select zplot 0-1 "ZplotTec"
